# Get Condition Details

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Gets a detail about the given condition.

## Syntax

~~~~text
conditionDetail(detail: <#Enumeration (WFContentItemPropertyName)#>, condition: <#Variable (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
conditionDetail(detail: Location, condition: Current Weather)
~~~~
